text: INT. DREAM SEQUENCE - DAY1 1

ABIGAIL ECHLOS (17) stands in the middle of nowhere. She looks around, confused. ABIGAIL (V.O.)Where am I? A mysterious WOMAN WEREWOLF appear not far behind her. They look at Abigail with sad, loving eyes. WEREWOLFAbby, my dear. Abby turns around in shock. ABIGAILMom? She runs to her and hugs her as tight as she can. Tears begin falling from her eyes. WEREWOLFI'm so sorry, Abby. I never wanted to leave you all by yourself. ABIGAILIt's okay, it's okay... Abigail shakes her head. MOMBut you have to stay strong. There's power buried deep within you...Abby. More than you know.She bends down and gently bites on her daughter's wrist, leaving a moon- shaped tattoo there. Abigail nods, still looking confused. Her image start to fade. ABIGAILWait...Mom, don't go...don't leave me...you're the only one I have left....Wait!!
INT. ABIGAIL'S BEDROOM - MORNING2 2
Abigail wakes up, there're tears on her face. She feels a slight pain on her wrist, looks down and sees the tattoo.
ABIGAIL (V.O.)It's not just a dream?INT. FRONT

character: DOOR OF THE HOUSE - MOMENTS LATER3 3
text: Abigail walks out, prepared to go to school. She sees IAN ECHLOS (18) standing by his car.IAN(impatiently) Hurry up. We don't have much time.

He sees Abigail's puffy eyes and awkwardly softens his tone. IANNo way...Were you crying? Just cause you're too afraid of school? ABIGAILMind your own business, Ian. IANHey, watch your attitude. If my dad weren't asking me to take care of you after that incident... Abigail shoots him a glare. Ian shuts up, rolls his eyes but opens the door for her. IAN(CONT’D)Fine. Get in the car.

A car brake sound. Ian parks the car on the street. ABIGAIL(looks at Ian withconfusion)We are not there yet. IANSince you told me to mind my own business, I figured I should let you take care of yourself. Plus, I don't want my friends to know that I'm cousins with a wolfless hybrid. Abigail unties the seatbelt and looks over at Ian. ABIGAILIt works both ways. With that, Abigail steps out of the car and slams the door hard.

Abigail walks on the street with her head kept low. All of a sudden, a loud roar from a motorcycle can be heard. Abigail looks back and sees a motorcycle rushing toward her. She is so scared that she forgets to move, and just as the motorcycle is about to hit her, she closes her eyes tight. However, the motorcycle stops right in front of her. Abigail slowly opens her eyes and sees AXEL HUNTER (17) take off his helmet and wave his long brown hair, revealing his handsome face. Abigail freezes and can feel her heartbeat racing. INSIDE ABIGAIL'S HEAD(with a vague voice)Ma...(te). (second half of the wordremains unheard)
EXT. STREET - DAY6 6

Abigail frowns and the sound can't be heard anymore. She looks up at Axel, who almost hit her, and walks over to a few friends. AXEL(to one of his friends)Hey, you enjoyed that party last night? Pretty cool huh? Then, they walk toward the campus without even looking back at Abigail. ABIGAIL(murmurs to Axel's back)What a jerk, he almost hit me, can't he at least say sorry?!
INT. CAMPUS BUILDING, CLASSROOM - DAY7 7
Abigail sits at the back of the classroom.
INT. CAMPUS BUILDING, HALLWAY - DAY8 8
Abigail walks in the hallway and keeps her head low.
INT. CAMPUS, CANTEEN - DAY9 9

Abigail stands in the middle of the canteen with a plate in her hand. She walks over to a booth and puts down her plate. However, just as she sits down at the booth, she suddenly senses everyone's attention is on her. GIRL AHow dare she sit in the Alpha's booth?! GIRL BThat new girl, she's so screwed. Abigail frowns, just as she picks up the fork, her plate is held by RACHEL LYNN (17). RACHELHey, you. This booth is not for you. ABIGAILWhat? RACHELSince you're new, let me introduce the rules of this canteen. With that, Rachel sits right next to Abigail. RACHEL(CONT’D)You see this booth is for the Alphas and their Betas. So,(with arms folded)What's your wolf? Everyone's attention is on them. ABIGAIL(stammers, her voice isgetting vague)I...hmm... I... I don't... I don't have my wolf yet. RACHEL(laughs)What? You don't even have your wolf? What are you? Wait a second, you're the hybrid? The waves of laughter can be heard, Abigail clenches her fist and looks up at Rachel.

ABIGAILYeah, you got a problem with that? RACHEL(with a mocking tone)When did the entry requirements get so low that even a hybrid can sit with us? Get your ass out of here, we don't have a place for you. With that, Rachel grabs a drink and pours it over Abigail's head. Just as it starts, Rachel is stopped by a strong grip. RACHEL(CONT’D)(shouts back)Who the hell dares to stop me from teaching this damn hybrid a lesson?! Both Rachel and Abigail turn around, it's Axel.
INT. CAMPUS, CANTEEN - DAY10 10

The drink which is in Rachel's hand falls on the floor. RACHELAxel? AXEL(interrupts Rachel'swords)You ruined my seats. Clean them up. Rachel forces a smile to Axel. RACHEL(to Abigail)Are you deaf? Clean up the seat. AXEL(to Rachel)I'm talking to you. Rachel's face burns, she crouches down and cleans the seats herself while glaring at Abigail fiercely. Seeing Abigail still standing with her plate, Axel steps in front of her. He stares at her, then murmurs to himself. AXEL(CONT’D)No way...

Abigail blushes as they get close to each other. ABIGAIL (V.O.)Is he actually kind of nice? AXELRachel just told you the rules, didn't she? Move. ABIGAIL (V.O.)And I'm taking that back. Just as Abigail stands in the middle of the canteen and doesn't know what to do, GRACE EVANS (17) walks over to Abigail. GRACEYou can sit with me if you want. RACHEL(scoffs)Hybrid with nerd, what a perfect match. With that, Rachel sits right next to Axel and cuts the steak for him. Grace brings Abigail to sit at the corner of the canteen. ABIGAILThanks for reaching out. But I hate to drag you down to my level. GRACE(shrugs)That's fine, I've been an outsider for a long time myself. I'm Grace. ABIGAIL(smiles at Grace)I'm Abigail, you can just call me Abby. GRACE(with a low voice)Tell me, Abby. I read that humans can choose their mates instead of following the moon goddess's will, is that true? Abigail nods and takes a sip of the drink.

GRACE(CONT’D)Holy smoke! That's so cool! So, have you already picked a mate? ABIGAIL(reveals a wry smile)Me? How would I have a mate? I don't even have my own wolf yet. With that, Abigail glances over at Axel's seat and happens to notice Axel is also staring at her. Grace notices their eye contact. GRACE(in a low voice)Oh, not him, Abby. That man's going to break your heart.

EXT. OUTSIDE OF THE HOUSE - NIGHT (MOMENTS EARLIER)25 25 Noah frowns and stares at Axel in his eyes. NOAHI know I'm not supposed to tell you this as your Beta, but seriously, do you care about that girl? If you want to keep her safe, you'd better use the mate bond between you two. Those Moon Shadow wolves are nothing but thugs. Axel clams down, closes his eyes, and takes a deep breath. A beat. Axel's eyes suddenly open and he runs into the woods.
AXEL(to Noah)This way!
INT. CAMPUS, CANTEEN - DAY11 11

Rachel notices Axel keeps staring at Abigail's table from time to time. RACHEL(with a pouting tone)Are you interested in that hybrid? Axel wipes off his mouth. He's definitely more focused on food than on Rachel. AXELIt's none of your business. With that, Axel walks out of the canteen. Rachel glares at Abigail. RACHEL(smirks)So the answer's yes, huh?
INT. CAMPUS BUILDING, HALLWAY - DAY12 12
Abigail takes out her bag from the locker and finds a frog jumping out of it.Everyone around her is laughing. Rachel is the loudest. Abigail catches the frog and frowns.

RACHELBe nice, hybrid. It's a mix breed of frogs and toads. You two are of the same kind. Abigail grabs the frog and walks toward Rachel, who is laughing even loudlier as she sees Axel standing aside. ABIGAILYou're gonna regret messing with me, Rachel. RACHELOh no. What're you gonna do, introduce your little friend to me? She giggles. ABIGAIL (V.O.)This idiot. She really thinks I'm just one of those cowards.Abigail approaches Rachel. The tattoo on her wrist flashes. A ball of shadow (or beam of red light) passes by Rachel's ankle, causing her to slip and fall to the ground. Abigail raises her eyebrows, surprised. Then she takes the chance to bend down and put the frog on top of Rachel's head. ABIGAILThis is all you got? What are you? A twelve-year-old? Rachel screams, stands up and runs away. Axel, who stands from some distance, watches the whole scene and smiles a bit. AXEL(to himself)That was funny.
INT. AXEL'S PACK HOUSE - NIGHT13 13
Axel sits on the sofa, Noah walks over. NOAHAlpha, your father is throwing a party for you this weekend. He wants you to invite people from your school too. AXELWhat's his problem again?

NOAHMy guess is, since every Alpha from this area has found their Luna, and you're turning 18- AXEL(interrupts him)I don't need a Luna. NOAHForgive me, sir. But it's an alpha's duty to... AXELScrew those stupid duties. With that, Axel gets up and leaves the house.

Axel drives the car on the street, he seems restless. All of a sudden, his eyes widen when he spots a familiar figure in an ice cream shop. AXEL (V.O.)(confused)It can't be...but what if I have already found her?
INT. ICE CREAM SHOP - NIGHT15 15

Axel walks into the ice cream shop, Abigail is cleaning the machine. She hears the door open. ABIGAILWelcome to Dairy- Abigail's word stops when she sees Axel walk into the shop. ABIGAIL (O.S.)(CONT’D)How did an Alpha end up in a human world's ice cream shop?! The boss sticks out his head from the back and glances at both of them. Abigail puts on her smile. ABIGAIL(CONT’D)(clears her throat)Welcome to Dairy Queen, how can I help you?

With that, the boss goes back to the kitchen. Axel walks over to the counter. AXELHuh, I don't know, can I try some? ABIGAILSure, what flavor do you want? AXEL(points at the green one)I want that one. Abigail scoops one for Axel. AXEL(CONT’D)(points at the yellow one)And that one.(points at the pink one)And that one too.

character: INT. ICE CREAM SHOP - MOMENTS LATER16 16
text: Axel casually throws a spoon into the trash can. ABIGAIL(with an angry tone)Have you made up your mind yet?

AXELI don't know. What's your favorite flavor? ABIGAILThat's none of your business. AXELDon't you ever give the customers any recommendation? For some reason...I think you might have a great taste ABIGAIL(grinds her teeth)You're going to get me fired. AXELYou know I could buy out the entire store if I want, do you? Abigail stares at him. Axel winks. Finally, she gives in, sighs and scoops another one for him.

Instead of taking the spoon from Abigail's hand, Axel deliberately leans over the counter and eats the spoonful of ice cream directly from Abigail's hand. Abigail doesn't expect Axel's movement, her face burns and her heartbeat races, her eyes start flashing red, she seems to hear the voice in her head again. INSIDE ABIGAIL'S HEADHe's my mate... Abigail freezes. Axel notices her reaction and licks his lips knowingly. AXELIt does taste good.(puts an invitation cardon the counter)Come to my party. With that, Axel walks out of the shop. Abigail stands at the counter like a statue. ABIGAIL (O.S.)He's... he's... my mate?

Axel organizes students into groups after his training, leaving Abigail without a team. AXELAnd the last team... Axel shifts his gaze from the student lists in his hand to the left of three girls Grace, Abigail, and Rachel. AXEL(CONT’D)(smiles)Grace Hartley and Rachel Gray. GRACE(protests)No! I don't wanna team up with her. I'm with Abby Rachel rolls her eyes. AXELIt's settled. Okay guys, you can start the team training now. Abigail looks around and finds her alone at the training ground.

AXEL(CONT’D)(interrupts her)Abigail Echlos, you're gonna team up with me. Grace insists on being on Abigail's team. GRACEWhat? Come on, Axel. I wanna team up with Abigail. RACHEL(with a pleading tone)Alpha, I want to be on your team. Axel refuses and sets the rule. AXEL(in a commanding tone)You can't switch unless you knock out your teammates first. Axel, with training gloves, holding a sandbag for Abigail, observes Abigail's punching the sandbag. Abigail wears gloves to hit the sandbag. AXEL(CONT’D)Nice boxing stance. You could be a fighter with more training. ABIGAIL(in a shy and a bit happytone)Thanks. He releases the sandbag and walks besides Abigail. AXEL(smiles and in a lowvolume)Hey, wait for me after class. I'll take you out for a lovely dinner Grace and Rachel, who happen to hear it, are both shocked. RACHEL(with a tone of anger anddisbelief)What? Abigail, punches the air, nearly losing her balance, but Axel catches her just in time.
INT. NICK'S HOUSE, ABIGAIL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT17 17

Abigail lies on the bed, stares at the invitation card, and frowns. ABIGAIL(murmur to herself)There's no way that he's my mate, I must have heard it wrong, I don't even have my own wolf yet. Stop kidding yourself, Abby! Abigail's phone rings. GRACE (V.O.)(from the other side ofthe phone)GRACE (V.O.) (CONT'D)Hey, did you hear about the party that holds for Axel to find his Luna? It's tomorrow night! ABIGAIL(over the phone)Hm... how did you know?

GRACE (V.O.)(from the other side ofthe phone)The whole school got invited. I bet Axel's dad is dying for Axel to find his Luna. Abigail reveals self-mocking laughs. ABIGAILGod, I'm so stupid to think that he only invited me... GRACE (V.O.)(from the other side ofthe phone)Abby? Are you there? Abigail comes back to her senses. ABIGAIL(over the phone)Yeah, sorry. GRACE (V.O.)(from the other side ofthe phone)So, what are you going to wear? ABIGAIL(over the phone)I'm not going. I... I have a night shift tomorrow at Dairy Queen... GRACE (V.O.)(from the other side ofthe phone, with a sweettone)Don't be silly girl, it's a party not just for Axel to find his Luna, it's also for us to find a mate. ABIGAIL(over the phone)I don't want a mate. ABIGAIL(CONT’D)Besides, you know I'm a hybrid, so I probably will never have one. GRACE (V.O.)(from the other side ofthe phone)What are you talking about?!
You will have your wolf. I'm going and you're going too! It's settled, end of discussion! With that, Grace hangs up the phone. Abigail sighs.

character: INT. AXEL'S HOUSE - THE NEXT DAY
text: Abigail slowly walks into the house, the minute she walks in, everyone's attention is on her again. NOAH (18) walks over. NOAHWelcome, may I have your coat, please? Abigail takes off her coat. She wears a red, silky dress that matches her ruby lips. Her hair is styled in waves and swept to one side, revealing her swan-like neck. She looks stunning.
The crowd gasps.

Abigail blushes as Axel wraps his arms around her waist. ABIGAIL(in a nervous tone)Is it a date? AXEL(smirks)What if it is? Axel rubs Abigail's waist, causing her to breathe heavily. Suddenly, a scream pierces the air as Grace takes down Rachel by punching Rachel's stomach. GRACEYou lose, loser! Rachel wails, covering her stomach.Grace stares at Axel in a cold look. GRACE(CONT’D)Alpha, can I team up with Abby now? Axel frowns and lets go of Abigail.

character: EXT. SCHOOL ENTRANCE - AFTER SCHOOL - AFTERNOON34 34
text: Abigail praises Grace who seems to lose her thought. ABIGAILGrace, it was so cool how you beat up Rachel in class. Grace pulls Abigail aside, concern in her eyes. GRACE(earnestly)Abby, don't go on a date with Axel. ABIGAIL(confused)Why? Grace, her voice filled with worry, confesses,

GRACEBecause all the girls who dated Axel end up getting dumped.I don't want to see you get hurt. Abigail pats Grace's hand or shoulder and smiles, reassuringly. ABIGAIL(with a bitter smile)It's not up to me to choose who is my mate, but don't worry Grace, I won't let myself get hurt. With that, Abigail hugs Grace. Just then, the voice of LUCAS ARCHER (21), the Alpha of the Moon Shadow pack., echoes behind Abigail. LUCASAbigail? My baby, is that truly you?

character: EXT. IN FRONT OF THE SCHOOL - AFTERNOON35 35
text: Lucas warmly embraces Abigail, complimenting her with a smile. LUCASYour violet eyes are still as beautiful and glowing as ever. Staring into them makes all worries disappear. Abigail, curious, questions Lucas about his unexpected visit to the public school. ABIGAILWhy are you here? LUCAS(with a low voice)Two of my members were imprisoned by a damn alpha. I come to seek help for their release. ABIGAIL(shocked)By who? Why?

Grace, intrigued, chimes in with Abigail inquiring about Lucas's identity. GRACE(whispers to Abigail)Who is he? Lucas casually places his arm around Abigail's waist, making her uncomfortable. He offers an introduction. LUCAS(smiling)Lucas Archer, Alpha of Moon Shadow pack, the man who claimed Abby's first kiss. Abigail, embarrassed, moves a step to the side, withdrawing from Lucas's embrace. She rolls her eyes and thinks to herself. ABIGAILThat was a silly incident on a trip when I was 10. Suddenly, Abigail remembers something. ABIGAIL(V.O.)Oh my gosh, could the Alpha that imprisoned Lucas's members be...

character: EXT. IN FRONT OF THE SCHOOL - AFTERNOON36 36
text: At the time, Axel arrives to pick up Abigail. He steps out of the car just in time to hear Lucas's remark, and his expression turns serious. AXEL(protectively)What's going on here?
INT. AXEL'S HOUSE, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT19 19

Noah puts Abigail's coat aside and when he passes by Axel, Noah reveals a sly smile. NOAH(in a low voice to Axel)It looks like your future Luna is getting everyone's attention. Axel glares at Noah. AXELShe's not gonna be my Luna. NOAHThen, tell your wolf to stay back. With that, Noah giggles and walks away. Axel glances over at Abigail who walks over to the corner of the house and holds a Coke tight in her hand. Just as Axel is about to walk over, Grace shows up and reaches Abigail first. GRACEOh my god, Abby! You look amazing!

ABIGAIL(smiles shy)Thanks. At the same time, Ian walks over and pats Abigail's back. IANStraighten up your back. If you're going to wear a dress like that, wear it like you're worth it. ABIGAILI'm sorry, do I know you? IAN(smirks)Good, keep it that way. From a distance, Axel spots the previous scene, and his hand holding the wine glass tightens. However, Axel's hand is covered by Rachel's hand. She takes the wine glass and puts it aside. Rachel's arm is around Axel's neck, leaning closer to Axel, Rachel's breast against Axel's chest. RACHEL(whispers to Axel)What are you staring at? Your room is upstairs, right? Why don't you give me a room tour? Axel glances at Abigail, who is still talking to Ian. His eyes turn red, and when Ian walks away, Abigail meets Axel's gaze. All of a sudden, Axel grabs Rachel by the back of her head and kisses her, but his eyes remain fixed on Abigail.

Axel notices Lucas's hand on Abigail's waist. He grabs Lucas's wrist to force Lucas's hand away from Abigail's waist as he warns. AXEL(to Lucas)Hands off, Alpha Lucas. Don't touch her, she's not for you!

Lucas raises his brow after hearing Axel's warning. LUCAS(turns to Abigail)What? When did you become a member of my rival pack, Abby? Don't tell me this jerk is your mate, my babe. Abigail begins to speak, but Axel cuts in.

AXEL(interrupts)That's none of your business. Axel opens a car door for Abigail. Axel swiftly ushers Abigail into his car, leaving Lucas(shows an expression of interest in Axel and Abigail's relationship) behind.
INT. AXEL'S HOUSE, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT20 20

When Axel and Abigail's eyes meet in the air, Grace suddenly walks over to Abigail. GRACEAbby, I've been trying to ask, how do you know Ian? Abby? Abigail doesn't seem to notice Grace's words, following Abigail's gaze, Grace finds Axel and Rachel kissing.

GRACE(CONT’D)(rolls her eyes)Rachel again, somebody tell them to get a room, please. Abigail comes back to her senses. ABIGAILWhat's that? GRACEAre you ok? Wait a second, don't tell me you have a crush Axel? ABIGAIL(smiles awkwardly)Of course not. What are you talking about? GRACEGreat, he's not a very nice Alpha. ABIGAILWhat do you mean? GRACEI heard that he's... what's the word for humans... let's see, he's a player, right, a player. ABIGAILPlayer? GRACEYeah, there's a rumor saying that he has been sleeping around within his pack and the school too, you'd better stay away from him. Abigail takes a sip of the Coke. ABIGAIL (V.O.)I'll try. The music begins, and Grace stands up right away, holding Abigail's hand and trying to pull her up too. GRACEIt's my favorite song! Come on, let's dance. ABIGAILI'm sorry Grace, but I'm not very good at dancing.

GRACECome on, I'm not going to let you sit there all night feeling sorry for yourself. It's easy, just move your body with the music. I'll teach you. Without any choice, Abigail stands up and dances with Grace. As Abigail slowly begins to enjoy the music and move her body, two men start dancing right behind her and Grace. One of the men whispers something to Grace. She giggles and takes Abigail, walking out of the house with the two men. At the same time, Rachel puts her hand on Axel's muscular chest, she looks at Axel with watery eyes. RACHEL(whispers to Axel's ear)Take me upstairs, I want you, my Alpha.
INT. AXEL'S HOUSE, LIVING ROOM - NIGHT21 21

Seeing Abigail walk out of the house with two strange men, Axel is furious. He pushes Rachel away. AXEL(to Rachel)Get off me! Rachel's eyes widen in shock. RACHELAxel? Axel gets off the sofa and looks around the room. AXEL(yells)Noah? Noah?! Noah runs over to Axel with a beer in his hand. NOAHWhat? AXELThat girl went off with two guys from the Moon Shadow pack.

NOAH(in a careless tone)What girl? With that, Noah attempts to drink a sip of the beer, but the beer is knocked on the floor by Axel. Seeing Axel's angry eyes, Noah comes to realize something. Then, he quickly follows up with Axel and rushes out of the house.

Grace and Abigail follow the two men and walk into the woods. Abigail looks around, and only the rustling sound of the leaves can be heard. ABIGAIL(whisper to Grace)Grace, this is weird, let's go back to the party. GRACEAbby, they are going to transfer, don't you wanna see it? Abigail bites her lips and frowns. Then the two men stop and slowly turn back to Abigail and Grace, revealing sly smiles.

character: EXT. OUTSIDE OF THE HOUSE - MOMENTS LATER23 23
text: Noah looks around and doesn't know where to find them. NOAH(to Axel)The woods out there are huge. There's no way we can find them... unless you can use the mate bond between you and your mate. She has a unique scent that only you can smell, which will help you locate her direction. AXELShe's not my mate.

character: EXT. WOODS - AT THE SAME TIME24 24
text: One of the men straddles Grace and tries to unrip her clothes. When Abigail tries to stop him, the other man catches her and slaps her hard to the ground.

GRACE(yells to Abigail)Don't mind me, run! Ignoring Grace's words, Abigail runs toward Grace again. No one notices, Abigail's wolf fur looming on her arms and a wolf tattoo appearing on her neck. However, Abigail is caught by one of the men. He slaps her hard across the face and grips her by the neck. MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)Trust your power, Abigail... Suddenly, the moon tattoo on Abigail's wrist flashes. Her eyes turn red for as short second and kicks the man away. But the other man attacks from the back and pushes her to the ground. She wants to fight back but the red fades, she fails. MAN 2There's no way for you to run now, bitch! Just as the man is about to push Abigail down to his crotch, a wolf comes out of nowhere and kicks the man on the ground. The man is furious, but he falls to the ground out of fear when he sees the wolf transform into a human figure. Abigail's eyes widen too, it's Axel.

Axel waits for Abigail in front of the building after her class. Recalling what happened last night, Abigail blushes when seeing Axel. ABIGAIL(nervously)Why are you here? Axel flashes a grin, sensing Abigail's shyness. AXEL(jokingly)You didn't wait for me this morning. So, here I am, delivering myself to you. Abigail feels relaxed and smiles at Axel. Axel crosses his arm around her shoulder and they head to the school gates. ABIGAILHave you let the two Moon Shadow members go? AXEL(sighs and frowns)I'm still in a bad mood after releasing the two jerks. ABIGAIL(smiling)But you avoid a war.

Abigail and Axel stop in front of the school gates. ABIGAIL(CONT’D)(stares into Axel's eyes)You've done a good job, Alpha Axel. Abigail pecks Axel on the lips. Axel smiles and takes her hand. AXELLet's grab a drink near the Royal building. As Abigail nods and they want to keep going, DAISY GRIMES (20) interrupts, calling Axel.. DAISY(enthusiastically)Axel! Axel frowns as he sees Daisy. Daisy runs over, hugs and kisses Axel who remains unresponsive. Daisy turns to Abigail. DAISY(CONT’D)(sarcastically)So, you're Axel's new toy. AXEL(coldly)Mind your language, Daisy! Aren't you supposed to be in Europe now? Daisy takes out a folded report from her pocket. DAISYI transferred back here. Because of this. Axel reads that pregnancy test, and Daisy drops the bombshell. DAISY(CONT’D)(smiling)I'm pregnant, and it's yours, Axel. Or I should call you hubby by now?

Axel is taken aback by Daisy's revelation, abruptly releasing Abigail's hand. Noah, noticing the tension, approaches. NOAHAxel, what happened? Axel glances down, revealing the pregnancy test in his hand. NOAH(CONT’D)(looking at the test)Eight weeks? Daisy smirks, slyly reminding Axel of their encounter. DAISYEight weeks ago, Axel. The night before I left for Europe. I'll never forget what happened in your car. Abigail's eyes widened, her hands trembling. Daisy, confidently, positions herself next to Axel, nudging Abigail aside. DAISY(CONT’D)(to Abigail)As for you, it's time for you to leave, don't you think? This is a family reunion here, You wouldn't want to feel like a third wheel, would you? Abigail's eyes reddened and covered her mouth to hold back the tears welling up in her eyes. Axel tightly grips the pregnancy test and takes Daisy's hand. AXELCome with me. Axel turns to Abigail and Noah. AXEL(CONT’D)(to Noah)Take her home, I'll be back soon. Noah nods and turns to Abigail.
NOAHCome on, Abigail.

Abigail still stares at the back of Axel who has taken Daisy to his car. As she turns around to follow Noah, Abigail sees Rachel. Rachel who happened to come out of the school, sees the scene. She seizes the opportunity to mock Abigail. RACHELHow does that feel? Seeing Axel taken away by another woman?
Rachel continues to mock Abigail.

RACHELI bet you'd be kicked out of this pack once they return. Abigail wipes away her tears, countering Rachel's taunt. ABIGAILSo you will cut steak for both Axel and that girl, huh? Noah chuckles and turns to Rachel. NOAHRachel, you have had no place meddling in Alpha's mess. Stay back. Then Noah says to Abigail who looks sad and lost. NOAH(CONT’D)Axel is taking Daisy to the hospital for confirmation. Abigail, we can wait for him at home. Abigail requests Noah to take her there. ABIGAILCan you take me to the hospital? NOAHI'm sorry. You know I have to follow his orders. Lucas arrives in his sports car, offering Abigail a ride.
LUCAS(grins)Hey Babe, need a ride? ABIGAIL(to Noah)I'll go by myself then. Noah shows a skeptical and worried look as he sees Abigail get into Lucas's car.

Abigail sits in Lucas's car and looks forward to seeing Axel. Her smile vanishes as she witnesses Axel smiling and kissing Daisy's stomach in front of the hospital entrance.
